import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = (int)1e9;
    static final int[] dx = {0,0,-1,1};
    static final int[] dy = {1,-1,0,0};
    static int n, t;
    static char[][] c, S;
    static int sx, sy;
    static int tot;
    static int[][] id;
    static int[][] dis;
    static int[][] vis;
    static int st, ed;
    static int k1 = 1;

    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, flow;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int flow) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static ArrayList<Edge>[] graph;
    static int[] level;
    static int[] it;

    static void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
        graph[from].add(new Edge(to, graph[to].size(), cap));
        graph[to].add(new Edge(from, graph[from].size()-1, 0));
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        level[st] = 0;
        q.offer(st);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : graph[v]) {
                if (e.flow > 0 && level[e.to] < 0) {
                    level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.offer(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[ed] >= 0;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int flow) {
        if (v == ed) return flow;
        for (; it[v] < graph[v].size(); it[v]++) {
            Edge e = graph[v].get(it[v]);
            if (e.flow > 0 && level[v] + 1 == level[e.to]) {
                int d = dfs(e.to, Math.min(flow, e.flow));
                if (d > 0) {
                    e.flow -= d;
                    graph[e.to].get(e.rev).flow += d;
                    return d;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxflow() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            Arrays.fill(it, 0);
            int f;
            while ((f = dfs(st, INF)) > 0) {
                flow += f;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static boolean check(int x, int y) {
        if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= n || y >= n) return false;
        if (vis[x][y] == 1) return false;
        if (c[x][y] < '0' || c[x][y] > '9') return false;
        return true;
    }

    static void Bfs() {
        vis = new int[n][n];
        dis = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(dis[i], INF);
        dis[sx][sy] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{sx, sy});
        vis[sx][sy] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int ax = p[0], ay = p[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = ax + dx[i], ny = ay + dy[i];
                if (check(nx, ny)) {
                    dis[nx][ny] = dis[ax][ay] + 1;
                    vis[nx][ny] = 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void Find(int tx, int ty, int idx) {
        int[][] Dist = new int[n][n];
        int[][] vis2 = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(Dist[i], INF);
        Dist[tx][ty] = 0;
        vis2[tx][ty] = 1;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{tx, ty});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int ax = p[0], ay = p[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = ax + dx[i], ny = ay + dy[i];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n && vis2[nx][ny] == 0 && c[nx][ny] >= '0' && c[nx][ny] <= '9') {
                    vis2[nx][ny] = 1;
                    Dist[nx][ny] = Dist[ax][ay] + 1;
                    if (Dist[nx][ny] < dis[nx][ny]) {
                        q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Dist[i][j] <= t && S[i][j] > '0' && S[i][j] <= '9' && Dist[i][j] <= dis[i][j]) {
                    addEdge(idx, id[i][j] + tot, INF);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        c = new char[n][n];
        S = new char[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            c[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            S[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        // find start Z
        sx = -1; sy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n && sx == -1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (c[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i; sy = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        // assign ids
        tot = 0;
        id = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                id[i][j] = ++tot;
            }
        }
        st = 2 * tot + 1;
        ed = st + 1;
        int nodeCount = ed + 1;
        graph = new ArrayList[nodeCount];
        for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++) graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        level = new int[nodeCount];
        it = new int[nodeCount];
        Bfs();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (c[i][j] > '0' && c[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(st, id[i][j], c[i][j] - '0');
                    Find(i, j, id[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (S[i][j] > '0' && S[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(id[i][j] + tot, ed, S[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(maxflow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
